CA.rationale: C and A are explicitly linked for a candidate record (command_estimate origin + red coordinate).

COD.rationale: Content (red at p0/current/n0), its presentation as coordinates, and an origin/status field are all explicitly present and bound to the same referent/time.

A.rationale: An explicit processing/estimate origin (command_estimate) is tied to the same candidate content and its red presentation.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content identifiers with named attributes (red/blue coordinates) are present.

D.rationale: Origin/status fields are provided separately from the coordinate content, distinguishing identity from status/organization metadata.

O.rationale: The report states how coordinates map to the grid and lists coordinate sets for specified contents, describing their presentation/organization.
